title: Cheapest Grading Service (2026)
verdict: The cheapest grading service depends on your stack: CGC at $10 for ten or more low-value cards, Beckett at $14.95 for one card if you can wait, and AGS at $15 to $18 for a measured grade in 20 business days or less.

The cheaper options are real and listed below with their terms. GMA and CGC undercut AGS on low-value bulk. What they do not include at that price is a measured report, subgrades on both sides and freedom from value caps.

why: One price covers everything. $18 buys the scan, the grade, eight subgrades, the report and the slab, for any card at any value. Orders of 30 or more TCG cards pay $15 a card on the standard bulk tier.

The terms are easy. There is no minimum submission, no membership and no contract, and AGS does not charge until the cards are graded and ready to ship. New customers get 20% off a first order with code AGSNEW20.

Every slab comes with the evidence. The digital report shows eight subgrades, centering data, high-resolution images and a color-coded heightmap of the surface, red on major flaws and green on clean areas. You can download it or share it by link, and the scan stays on file against the cert number.

faq.q: What is the cheapest grading service?
faq.a: GMA and CGC list the lowest fees, with minimum orders and value caps. AGS is next at $15 to $18 and includes subgrades, a report and no value cap.

faq.q: Which card grader has the lowest listed price?
faq.a: As of November 18, 2026, GMA is lowest at $12 a card with a 25-card minimum, or $9 at 100 cards. CGC's bulk tier is $10 with a 10-card minimum on cards worth up to $500. Beckett's Base tier is $14.95, and ISA and AGS bulk are $15.

faq.q: Do graders charge more for valuable cards?
faq.a: Several do. PSA and SGC price by declared value, and CGC caps each tier by card value and moves a card up if it is worth more. AGS, Beckett, TAG and ISA say they add no upcharge for value.

faq.q: Is there a minimum number of cards?
faq.a: Not at AGS. You can send one card at $18, and bulk pricing needs 30. CGC's bulk tier needs 10 cards, ISA needs 10, and GMA needs 10 to 25 depending on the tier.

faq.q: What costs come on top of the grading fee?
faq.a: Shipping to the grader, return shipping and insurance, and supplies such as penny sleeves and card savers. Some graders add membership fees, subgrade fees or value upcharges. AGS adds return shipping at checkout.
